freetoken_hybrid.from: FreeToken (FlashML), CPU computes misses while the GPU computes hits

engine_as_is.why: 64 GB desktop: ~25 GB of RAM free for its expert bank, VRAM cache can only hold RAM-resident experts, most picks fault in from NVMe

freetoken_hybrid.note: in-process A/B, order alternated; round 0 is the cold first round

profile_residency.from: omxpert: profile from the owner's chat history picks the VRAM experts
profile_residency.note: separate servers interleaved fit, pinned, fit, pinned; same prompts (held-out chat sessions) and server timings

layer_ahead_prefetch.note: previous token's cold picks of the next layer, madvise WILLNEED by 8 reader threads

predictor_prefetch.from: omxpert learned guesser + Fate's cross-layer gate idea
predictor_prefetch.reason: learned table guesses pinned experts too and would pull their RAM back (pinned mode pages them out); needs a pin filter in ggml-cpu. Offline on chat: 44.5% of next-layer picks with 16 guesses (49.1% with recency). Cross-layer gate needs hidden states in the CPU op (not built).

read_pool.note: the reader pool only does work when prefetch is on: same arm as layer_ahead_prefetch

mtp.note: pinned stack with 33 GB of pins (the draft head takes VRAM)

staged_prefill.reason: night 5 measured no gain on ~550-token prompts (22.9/149 vs 22.6/150); tonight's prompt fix is per-layer placement (EDX_PREFILL_LOCAL) instead

exclusive_tiers.note: separate runs, chat prompts, client timings; pinned experts' RAM is given back (EDX_PAGEOUT)

steering.from: omxpert (swap a pick for a VRAM expert; Skliar et al.'s cache-conditional routing)
